name: fminunc
comment: Sig: [x,fval,exitflag] = fminunc(fun, x0). Unconstrained minimization via embedded-.m BFGS quasi-Newton with a central-difference gradient and Armijo backtracking line search (inverse-Hessian estimate H, reset to I on a non-descent direction). Objective is user code -> bytecode (pausable). Parity on the SOLUTION (the minimiser); tol 1e-4 since MATLAB's quasi-newton stops at ~[0.99999 0.99998] on Rosenbrock (numkit's central-FD BFGS converges tighter, both ~[1 1]). Fingerprint: parabola (x-3)^2 -> 3, quadratic bowl -> [1 -2] (fval 3), Rosenbrock -> [1 1]. Output orientation mirrors x0. Verified vs MATLAB R2025b. Fixes bugs/optim/fminunc (split from constrained-solvers cluster; quadprog/linprog/fmincon remain).
